name: AMOLED Calling Smartwatch
subtitle: Round AMOLED display with Bluetooth calling
description: A round smartwatch with a 1.39-inch AMOLED touchscreen, 464 × 464 resolution, and Bluetooth calling support. It also provides voice assistant support, heart rate and sleep tracking, multiple activity modes, smart notifications, and Android and iOS compatibility.
story: The watch combines communication and daily tracking in a round-dial format with a brown leather-style strap. Pair it with a compatible smartphone to use Bluetooth calling and receive supported notifications without checking the phone for every update. The 464 × 464 AMOLED touchscreen is the main interface for watch functions, while heart rate, sleep, and activity features provide recorded wellness information. Battery life is listed as up to 7 days under typical usage. Exact battery capacity and water-resistance details were not supplied.
highlights: Bluetooth calling with speaker and microphone
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
